notes.title: Update 1.1.10 – System Improvements & TPS Fest
notes.content:
\[1.1.10]
We’re getting ready to release Update 1.1.10 for Protocol:null very soon!

This update brings new content, gameplay improvements, optimizations, and balance changes to keep the experience smoother and more engaging.


New Content
New Attachment: Coller – improves regeneration for the AN-4 Pistol.

New Objective Indicator – clearer tracking of mission objectives.


Car & Gameplay
Improved car movement system.

Higher spawn chance for car upgrades (Airfoil & Frontlip).

Clearer objective visuals with updated car scenario textures.


Characthers
Large improvements on camera system and mouse sensitivity.

Adjusted character rotation – camera no longer rotates with the character.

Better handling on some walkable surfaces.


Enemies
Adjustments to enemy despawn system.

Adjustments on round system.


Balancing
Reduced overall weapon recoil.

Adjusted ACOG zoom

Faster AN-4 pistol cooldown.

Increased AN-4 pistol capacity.


Optimization
Reduced poly count on scenario vehicles.

Updated car scenario textures – better visualization and clearer objectives.

Improved bullet system performance.



Stay tuned – Update 1.1.10 is just around the corner, and will also be featured during the TPS Fest!
